review: V0.9 playable source and finite Node event review
conclusion: No remaining startup or ordinary day-flow blocking problem was found within the source/API scope. This does not establish browser rendering, mobile usability or browser storage correctness.

findings.original_problem: Bag use resumed time and dismissed its dialog before an in-progress world action caused usePracticeItem to reject the item. The original item remained, but the chase resumed with only a generic toast.
findings.reproduction: Claim job food; start F12; walk to the stationery shelf; begin the one-second take_clips action; open the bag before completion; attempt food use.
findings.current_fix: Only active sessions without a world action expose usable buttons. The callback guards again, commits use synchronously, restores pause and keeps an explanatory bag dialog on failure, and dismisses the dialog only after success.
findings.evidence: Original behavior reproduced through public APIs. Current callback body extracted from source and executed against the actual Session API with plain Node element stubs.

findings.original_problem: Finished exercises displayed apparently usable bag buttons whose callback silently returned.
findings.current_fix: Finished exercises show an explicit notice and disabled buttons; the callback retains its terminal-state guard.
findings.evidence: Static source inspection and terminal-state callback simulation.

findings.hypothesis: Clearing UI keys and pointers without clearing the world direction could cause automatic movement after pause.
findings.evidence: Every reviewed UI pause route uses Session.setPracticePaused, which clears both world direction and path when pausing. A pure Node run confirmed no paused time advance and no player movement on resume without new input.

source_checks.detail: All 20 distinct Cycle/Session/World functions referenced by the entry module exist as callable exports: 9 Cycle, 10 Session, 1 World.
All 45 literal element IDs referenced by the entry module are present in the template or dynamically declared markup. This is textual matching, not a browser DOM test.
Ordinary actions pass actionId; learning passes A03 and a declared pageId; purchase passes declared itemId; use passes actual item-instance ID; prep and commute use their corresponding calendar APIs.

D-pad pointerdown sets capture; pointerup, pointercancel and lostpointercapture release direction. Keyup releases keys; blur and hidden-document paths clear keys/pointers and pause through the session adapter.
Latest CSS declares 44px minimums for directional, action, emergency, top action, dialog close, aim-cancel and inventory-use buttons. Computed dimensions and viewport fit were not measured.

Successful day actions serialize the day state; visibility hiding saves the parent day state; restore exceptions produce a fresh day and a warning. Practice state is a separate fork and is not written to the day storage key.

node_public_api_observations.detail: 08:00 claim food; study K01; complete five sleep slots; reach 20:00 preparation; buy and consume one I05; serialize/restore; finish prep and commute. K01, original objects, daily claim and coffee debt survive restore. Coffee consumed at minute 1200 settles at 1260 during prep; commute ends at minute 1440 with night_ready and zero remaining slots.
After actual directional movement, pausing cleared direction/path, advancing while paused did not change world time, and resuming without a new input did not move the player.

node_public_api_observations.flow: bag during actual work before fix
node_public_api_observations.detail: Actual walk to the stationery anchor and take_clips began successfully; the original unpause-then-use sequence returned exercise_not_available_for_item without consuming food and left time unpaused.

node_extracted_callback_simulations.method: The current data-use onclick function body was read from playable_v09.mjs and executed in Node with the real Session module and small plain-object stand-ins for three elements. No browser DOM or event dispatch was used.
assertions_satisfied: In-progress world work guards retain pause, dialog and original item.
Successful actual consumption occurs before dialog dismissal and unpauses the exercise.
Repeated use of an already-consumed item keeps the dialog open, restores pause and sets feedback.
The third mint in one encounter is rejected with the declared reason; the third original mint remains unconsumed and time stays paused.
A naturally finished exercise retains pause and original inventory when the callback is invoked.

unverified: Actual browser execution and visual rendering.
Real mobile touch/pointer-capture behavior and viewport/scroll fit.
Real browser storage permissions, persistence across navigation and reload.
Full-night UI, which is outside this two-exercise slice.
notes: No browser automation, external hosting or access workaround was attempted by this reviewer. No previously frozen documentation or repository source was edited during this review.

browser_acceptance.native_attempt: Chromium window opened, but the native input interface could not connect to the accessibility provider.
browser_acceptance.cloud_attempt: Local file URL was rejected by the browser URL policy; no alternate protocol or hosting workaround was attempted.
